name: Timken India Ltd
title: Timken India Ltd - 522113 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Timken India FY26 standalone revenue hit a record INR3,148 crore (+8.6%) with 15.5% PBT margin, but cost pass-through is only 10% achieved and the Bharuch plant is near breakeven, targeting 70% utilisation by July.

capex.quote: we spent roughly around 8.5% of our revenue. That's very close to the capex spend.

triggers.label: Price pass-through only 10% achieved
triggers.quote: we are at 10% currently. So, the massive work is underway.

triggers.label: Bharuch utilisation target 70% by July
triggers.quote: we should be July, August, we should start seeing utilization of about 70%.

triggers.label: Export Q4 INR222 crore, +40% QoQ
triggers.quote: we did INR222 crores, which was 21% of our pie

triggers.label: Bharuch plant still near breakeven
triggers.quote: We are still very close to the breakeven

guidance.quote: I can tell you we will outgrow the market.
we should be July, August, we should start seeing utilization of about 70%.

evasions.quote: I don't think we can give you a percentage guidance either on the bottom line or the top line.
